matplotlib__matplotlib-25311.issue_summary: A figure containing a draggable legend cannot be pickled because the stored canvas includes objects that cannot be serialized.
matplotlib__matplotlib-25311.diagnosis_summary: Claude and Gemini trace the inheritance hierarchy to the shared draggable implementation and add serialization handling. The three GPT trials avoid the immediate serialization error but do not preserve draggable behavior after loading and cover only selected subclasses.
matplotlib__matplotlib-25311.interpretation_note: The assessed requirement includes behavior after deserialization, rather than merely successful pickle creation.

sympy__sympy-15345.issue_summary: The Mathematica printer emits Python-style syntax for Max and Min expressions.
sympy__sympy-15345.diagnosis_summary: The passing trials provide suitable printing logic. GPT trial 2 also removes the StrPrinter.doprint delegation and changes _format_code, altering the existing string-output and argument-ordering behavior. It is the only failed trial for this task.

django__django-15022.issue_summary: Admin searches containing several terms can create unnecessary joins over related fields.
django__django-15022.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 1 and Gemini trial 2 retain sequential filters precisely when joins are possible, leaving the expensive case unchanged. Gemini trial 1 uses subqueries without eliminating the repeated joins; Gemini trial 3 uses an existence-based strategy that does not satisfy the tested behavior. The notes also describe a candidate combined-filter strategy being reconsidered after a repository test whose expected result is updated by the benchmark test patch.
django__django-15022.interpretation_note: A repository test whose expected result changes with the accepted fix can influence the repair direction when the agent runs the original test unchanged.

django__django-14140.issue_summary: Q.deconstruct assumes a single child is a key/value tuple and fails for expression children such as Exists.
django__django-14140.diagnosis_summary: Claude trials 1 and 3, all Gemini trials, and GPT trial 3 guard the tuple-specific branch while preserving the older keyword-argument representation. These patches avoid the reported indexing error but do not produce the positional-argument deconstruction format checked by the benchmark tests.
django__django-14140.interpretation_note: Avoiding the indexing crash does not by itself satisfy the required serialization contract.

django__django-11532.issue_summary: A non-ASCII hostname can cause email Message-ID generation to fail under a legacy email encoding.
django__django-11532.diagnosis_summary: Claude trials 1 and 3 and GPT trials 1 and 3 convert the hostname at Message-ID creation but leave a Unicode value in the shared DNS cache. Claude trial 2 introduces another cache attribute that the test cleanup does not reset. GPT trial 2 has a repeated-call logic defect. The passing Gemini trials avoid the problematic cached representation.

sphinx-doc__sphinx-8548.issue_summary: The inherited-members option omits inherited instance attributes and their documentation.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-8548.diagnosis_summary: The failed trials focus on retrieving or rendering documentation without completing member discovery. Gemini does not update importer.py to include the inherited instance attributes, while Claude trials 2 and 3 and GPT trials 2 and 3 likewise omit the discovery prerequisite. An attribute assigned in a base-class initializer cannot be discovered solely through dir() on the derived class.

sphinx-doc__sphinx-8056.issue_summary: Napoleon does not correctly handle NumPy-style documentation that gives several parameter names on one declaration line.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-8056.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 1 splits names without respecting napoleon_use_param=False; trial 2 splits type fields without the corresponding parameter fields. GPT trial 1 changes the list-style output and removes class markup, trial 2 falls back to list formatting despite napoleon_use_param=True, and trial 3 groups parameter declarations separately from type declarations. The passing Claude and Gemini alternatives split names at an output stage while matching the tested format.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-8056.interpretation_note: The checked field ordering and configuration-dependent output are part of the benchmark contract; similar rendered text alone does not establish equivalence.

psf__requests-2931.issue_summary: Requests coerces byte request bodies to strings instead of sending the original bytes.
psf__requests-2931.diagnosis_summary: The repair must preserve body bytes while retaining the conversion needed for byte-valued URL parameters. Gemini trials 1 and 3 and GPT trials 2 and 3 return bytes early from _encode_params without handling the URL case. GPT trial 1 passes with a decode-or-return fallback that separates the evaluated body and URL inputs.

django__django-14155.issue_summary: A resolver representation does not display useful details when its view is a functools.partial object.
django__django-14155.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials unwrap partial objects and lose information about their bound arguments. The reference implementation instead uses the partial object representation for this case, preserving the underlying callable and supplied arguments.

matplotlib__matplotlib-26208.issue_summary: Creating a twinned axis can corrupt the data limits of an existing plot with categorical units.
matplotlib__matplotlib-26208.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials concentrate on limit-management code and nearby TODO comments. They do not propagate the original axis unit information to the twin, leaving the underlying categorical-unit mismatch unresolved.

django__django-10554.issue_summary: Evaluating a derived union queryset can affect its source queryset and leave required ordering columns absent from generated SQL.
django__django-10554.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 1 submits reproduction or test code without a production fix. Claude trials 2 and 3, Gemini trials 2 and 3, and GPT trials 1 and 3 clone shared subqueries but do not repair SQL projection for ordering. Gemini trial 1 and GPT trial 2 remove ordering rather than preserve the required query behavior.
django__django-10554.interpretation_note: The failure analysis distinguishes shared-state mutation from the SQL projection requirement for ordering combined queries.

scikit-learn__scikit-learn-26194.issue_summary: The first ROC threshold uses a finite sentinel that can be confusing for probability-valued prediction scores.
scikit-learn__scikit-learn-26194.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials calculate or clip to a finite initial threshold. The accepted behavior represents the no-positive-predictions point with positive infinity, and the benchmark tests explicitly require that sentinel. The issue includes a tentative clipping suggestion that differs from the accepted change.
scikit-learn__scikit-learn-26194.interpretation_note: A threshold above the largest score is not intrinsically invalid. The relevant failure is disagreement with the specified infinity-sentinel behavior, not that finite thresholds necessarily produce an incorrect ROC point.

pylint-dev__pylint-4661.issue_summary: Pylint stores persistent statistics in a legacy home-directory location instead of a platform-appropriate cache directory.
pylint-dev__pylint-4661.diagnosis_summary: Claude trials 1 and 3, Gemini trials 1 and 3, and all GPT trials select a data-directory location. Claude trial 2 and Gemini trial 2 choose a cache directory but implement a narrower manual path rule. The reference change uses appdirs to obtain the platform cache location, and the benchmark tests compare against appdirs.user_cache_dir.
pylint-dev__pylint-4661.interpretation_note: The diagnostic distinction is required path and platform behavior, rather than merely the choice to use a dependency.

sphinx-doc__sphinx-11510.issue_summary: Including a reStructuredText file bypasses the source-read event used by extensions to transform source content.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-11510.diagnosis_summary: Claude, GPT, and Gemini trial 2 replace substantial parts of the include implementation, introducing behavior differences. Gemini trial 1 supplies the including document name rather than the included document name to the event. Gemini trial 3 supplies a source path instead of the document name and also emits an event for literal text inclusion that the tests exclude. The reference patch intercepts insert_input during include processing.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-11510.interpretation_note: The relevant defects concern event identity and include semantics; patch size alone does not establish failure.

pylint-dev__pylint-8898.issue_summary: Comma-separated regular-expression options are split inside repetition quantifiers such as {1,3}.
pylint-dev__pylint-8898.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 2 handles quantifier commas while preserving the existing configuration parser conventions and passes. Claude trials 1 and 3 and GPT trials 2 and 3 change grouping-sensitive splitting; Gemini trials 1 and 3 and GPT trial 1 use CSV parsing without resolving the quantifier case. Gemini trial 2 correctly traces the parser and adopts a quoting/escaping workaround, but its generic CSV escape rule consumes existing regex backslashes and changes matching semantics. Configuration deletion is a secondary execution defect.
pylint-dev__pylint-8898.interpretation_note: The issue explicitly permits escaping, so disagreement with the raw-quantifier test alone does not establish P1. The S2 classification is based on the independently demonstrated regex-semantic regressions.

django__django-15741.issue_summary: get_format does not accept a lazy string argument, affecting consumers such as the date template filter.
django__django-15741.diagnosis_summary: Claude and Gemini convert the argument to a string and pass, using force_str and str respectively. All three GPT trials return without performing the required conversion, leaving downstream consumers with the unsupported lazy argument.

django__django-13023.issue_summary: DecimalField lets exceptions from invalid nonnumeric inputs escape instead of converting them consistently to ValidationError.
django__django-13023.diagnosis_summary: Gemini trials 1 and 3 and GPT trials 2 and 3 modify the model DecimalField but omit ValueError from its exception handling. Claude trial 2 instead modifies the form-field DecimalField, leaving the model-field conversion path targeted by the issue and tests unchanged. Passing trials handle the required exception types in the target module.
django__django-13023.interpretation_note: The additional ValueError case distinguishes four incomplete exception-handling repairs from Claude trial 2, which instead changes the wrong module and leaves the target conversion path untouched.

django__django-13406.issue_summary: Reassigning a pickled query to a queryset does not restore the iterable behavior needed for values-based query results.
django__django-13406.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 2 and all three Gemini trials preserve the original values_list result structure, while the benchmark expects dictionary-like values results when only the query is restored. GPT trial 1 has a separate implementation-state failure: a compound edit partially applies before its final awk stage fails, and an uninspected residual assignment inside QuerySet.values_list makes query.py syntactically invalid.
django__django-13406.interpretation_note: The four result-contract failures are V1 cases. GPT trial 1 is an I1 case because the failed compound edit leaves an unrecovered syntax error before the query-restoration behavior can be exercised.

django__django-11790.issue_summary: AuthenticationForm no longer sets the username widget maxlength as expected.
django__django-11790.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 1, all Gemini trials, and GPT trial 2 store a string-valued maxlength where the tests expect an integer. GPT trials 1 and 3 defer the adjustment until rendering, whereas the tests inspect the earlier form state. The remaining Claude trials pass.
django__django-11790.interpretation_note: A matching HTML rendering can coexist with a different internal attribute type or initialization time. These are separate contracts.

django__django-13343.issue_summary: FileField deconstruction serializes an evaluated storage instance instead of retaining the supplied storage callable.
django__django-13343.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 2 changes storage into a property and fails the evaluated initialization and deconstruction behavior. The passing trials retain access to the original callable while preserving the expected storage interface.

astropy__astropy-14182.issue_summary: The reStructuredText table writer does not accept additional header_rows such as units.
astropy__astropy-14182.diagnosis_summary: The seven failed trials implement header writing without adjusting where the reader starts table data. The two passing trials account for the number of header rows when setting the data start line, supporting the tested write/read behavior.

sympy__sympy-18211.issue_summary: Converting a relational expression that cannot be solved explicitly into a set raises an error instead of returning a symbolic set.
sympy__sympy-18211.diagnosis_summary: Gemini trials 1 and 2 handle equalities but leave the relevant inequality path unchanged; GPT trial 1 likewise has incomplete relational coverage. Claude trial 3 and Gemini trial 3 change a lower-level solver to return ConditionSet, altering its existing return contract rather than handling the fallback at the relational conversion boundary.
sympy__sympy-18211.interpretation_note: The appropriate fallback boundary matters: changing a lower-level solver return type also affects callers other than Relational.as_set.

scikit-learn__scikit-learn-13135.issue_summary: KBinsDiscretizer with the kmeans strategy can construct nonmonotonic bin edges from unsorted cluster centers.
scikit-learn__scikit-learn-13135.diagnosis_summary: GPT trial 2 sorts the resulting bin edges rather than sorting the centers before calculating boundaries, leaving an incorrect discretization strategy. The notes link this direction to an earlier edit command that did not apply as intended. Passing trials sort the centers; some also retain an unnecessary later edge sort.
scikit-learn__scikit-learn-13135.interpretation_note: The ineffective initial edit and the incorrect final discretization logic are distinct parts of the recorded failure.

sphinx-doc__sphinx-10323.issue_summary: literalinclude applies dedentation after prepend and append, removing indentation intentionally supplied by those options.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-10323.diagnosis_summary: GPT trial 2 adds indentation inference inside prepend_filter and append_filter instead of limiting the repair to filter order. This changes the established behavior of the prepend and append options and is the only failed trial for this task.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-10323.interpretation_note: The failure concerns an unnecessary semantic change in option handling, not the intended ordering repair itself.

django__django-16560.issue_summary: Model constraints cannot consistently expose a configurable validation error code.
django__django-16560.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 1, all Gemini trials, and GPT trials 1 and 3 omit the PostgreSQL ExclusionConstraint subclass while updating more central constraint classes. GPT trial 2 is assigned to incomplete compatibility handling. Gemini trials 2 and 3 and GPT trial 3 additionally replace the legacy unique_together code for field-based uniqueness, violating the compatibility expectation in the tests.
django__django-16560.interpretation_note: Some trials exhibit more than one defect. A single primary category is an annotation convention and should not imply that other observed defects are absent.

django__django-13344.issue_summary: An asynchronous middleware chain can return an unawaited coroutine where an HTTP response is expected.
django__django-13344.diagnosis_summary: The failed trials attempt to infer asynchronous behavior in the lower-level exception handler from wrapped callbacks. This treats downstream symptoms without correcting the middleware initialization or capability information at the appropriate layer. Claude trial 2 and Gemini trials 1 and 2 pass.

matplotlib__matplotlib-26291.issue_summary: An inset axes operation fails during tight-bounding-box computation when the renderer is not available through the expected path.
matplotlib__matplotlib-26291.diagnosis_summary: GPT trial 1 changes the figure state but does not supply the required renderer to the downstream operation. The other eight trials complete the renderer-handling repair and pass.

sympy__sympy-17630.issue_summary: Block-matrix operations reduce a ZeroMatrix to scalar zero, breaking later matrix operations.
sympy__sympy-17630.diagnosis_summary: The eight failed trials modify block multiplication without correcting the matrix-addition behavior that still produces scalar zero. Gemini trial 1 is the only passing trial.

scikit-learn__scikit-learn-15100.issue_summary: strip_accents_unicode leaves combining accents in strings that are already normalized into decomposed form.
scikit-learn__scikit-learn-15100.diagnosis_summary: Claude trial 3 has repeated action-format and editing problems. The notes describe an edit-and-cleanup sequence that removes unrelated vectorizer implementation while the agent checks only the intended accent fix. The other eight trials pass with accent removal that also handles already-normalized strings.

matplotlib__matplotlib-20859.issue_summary: Legend rejects SubFigure as a valid parent even though a SubFigure can host its own legend.
matplotlib__matplotlib-20859.diagnosis_summary: Gemini trial 2 treats SubFigure like an Axes-style container and redirects ownership to the outer figure. This fails to preserve the SubFigure as the legend host. The other eight trials pass.

sphinx-doc__sphinx-9591.issue_summary: A property return annotation is displayed as plain text instead of being parsed into a reference.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-9591.diagnosis_summary: GPT trial 3 reformats the annotation upstream but does not change the downstream branch that emits it as plain text. Without invoking the annotation parser in that branch, the required link is still absent. The other eight trials pass.

django__django-15103.issue_summary: json_script requires an element identifier even when the caller does not need one.
django__django-15103.diagnosis_summary: Claude trials 1 and 2 make the low-level utility argument optional but omit the corresponding template-filter entry point. Their reproduction focuses on direct Python calls. The remaining trials cover the relevant interface change and pass.

django__django-13401.issue_summary: Field copies inherited from abstract models share a creation counter and can be incorrectly treated as equal across models.
django__django-13401.diagnosis_summary: GPT trial 2 uses object identity as an ordering tie-breaker. That ordering differs from the deterministic model-based ordering expected by the tests. The other eight trials preserve the required equality and ordering behavior.
django__django-13401.interpretation_note: Object identity distinguishes objects but does not implement a stable model-name ordering.

django__django-12125.issue_summary: Migration serialization uses an unqualified class name for nested classes, generating an invalid import path.
django__django-12125.diagnosis_summary: Gemini trial 3 adds module-search logic around the existing path instead of using the nested class qualified name at serialization. The other eight trials use the relevant qualified-name information and pass.

matplotlib__matplotlib-24570.issue_summary: HPacker reverses top and bottom alignment.
matplotlib__matplotlib-24570.diagnosis_summary: GPT trial 1 inspects the shared alignment helper and both packers, then deliberately remaps top/bottom only in HPacker. This leaves VPacker top/bottom behavior unfixed and is the earliest unrecovered logical omission (S1). A later extension of the remapping to left/right also reverses HPacker placement, a secondary strategy defect.
matplotlib__matplotlib-24570.interpretation_note: The observed differences are numeric layout behavior, not merely output formatting. Under the manuscript single-primary rule, the earlier incomplete fix is counted once as S1; the later S2 manifestation is not counted again.

django__django-11276.issue_summary: Django intends to replace its custom HTML escaping implementation with the standard-library implementation.
django__django-11276.diagnosis_summary: All three Gemini trials call html.escape but then convert the apostrophe entity back from ' to '. This preserves the former output spelling and fails the exact output expected after the accepted refactoring. Claude and GPT pass.
django__django-11276.interpretation_note: Both apostrophe entities denote the same HTML character. The recorded mismatch concerns the exact output contract; its performance effect was not measured.

django__django-14771.issue_summary: The development-server autoreloader does not propagate interpreter -X options to the child process.
django__django-14771.diagnosis_summary: Gemini trial 2 and the three GPT trials emit separate argument tokens such as ["-X", "utf8"], while the tests expect the combined form ["-Xutf8"]. The remaining trials match the tested subprocess argument structure.
django__django-14771.interpretation_note: Alternative command-line spellings can be accepted by the interpreter. The failure here is the exact argument-vector contract checked by the benchmark, rather than proof that the alternative never works.

django__django-16502.issue_summary: The development server does not consistently suppress a response body for HEAD requests.
django__django-16502.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials remove the body but fail the benchmark checks on response-header handling, including the expected absence of Content-Length in the tested case.
django__django-16502.interpretation_note: The absence of Content-Length is a case-specific benchmark expectation and does not imply that HTTP forbids a Content-Length header in every HEAD response.

astropy__astropy-8872.issue_summary: Quantity construction promotes a float16 input to float64 instead of preserving the floating-point dtype.
astropy__astropy-8872.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials exempt floating and complex inputs from conversion but convert every other dtype to float64. This changes boolean behavior. The reference change narrows conversion to the intended integer and object kinds, preserving other previously supported dtypes.

matplotlib__matplotlib-21568.issue_summary: Date-axis labels have unclear spacing when usetex is enabled.
matplotlib__matplotlib-21568.diagnosis_summary: Claude and Gemini focus on spacing around colons, while GPT makes broader rendering changes. The resulting strings do not provide the explicit TeX spacing required by the tests, leaving ordinary spaces where TeX math mode does not preserve the intended spacing. All nine trials fail.

sympy__sympy-12489.issue_summary: Permutation methods construct base-class instances instead of preserving a subclass.
sympy__sympy-12489.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials update selected _af_new paths but leave other constructors or hard-coded base-class references unchanged. The tests substitute a subclass and expose the remaining construction paths that do not preserve it.

django__django-15732.issue_summary: Dropping a single-field unique_together constraint is ambiguous when another uniqueness constraint exists on that field.
django__django-15732.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials exclude a primary-key constraint but do not handle the distinct unique=True constraint case. Multiple non-primary unique constraints remain candidates, so the operation still fails the second evaluated scenario.

django__django-15629.issue_summary: Foreign keys do not consistently inherit the collation of their referenced primary-key field.
django__django-15629.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials update the foreign-key definition used during table creation but omit schema alteration logic that must synchronize existing foreign keys when the primary-key collation changes. Creation tests can pass while alteration tests fail.

sphinx-doc__sphinx-7748.issue_summary: Autodoc recognizes only the first of several leading signatures in a function docstring.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-7748.diagnosis_summary: The failed patches add support for reading several signatures but leave multiline signature normalization incomplete. Continuation backslashes remain in output checked by the tests, including the return-annotation handling in Gemini trial 1. All nine trials are labeled as failures.

astropy__astropy-13398.issue_summary: Transforming nearby terrestrial objects from ITRS to observed coordinates through an inertial frame introduces inappropriate aberration effects.
astropy__astropy-13398.diagnosis_summary: All nine failed trials introduce a direct transformation path but omit atmospheric refraction handling. The geometric near-Earth case can improve while the refraction-dependent cases required by the tests remain unsupported.
